text:
Priya (CS): just wrapped an onboarding call with SolarWave — two asks that felt like blockers for them: 1) ability to toggle per-route billing at the account level (they want to exclude internal test routes) 2) clearer onboarding docs for cost attribution. Renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks, account health ~72%.

Jordan (PM): thanks Priya — can you paste the exact customer quote? also please add to the product tracker and tag priority. on first pass this reads medium impact / low effort but need data.

Priya (CS): exact AM quote: "If we can't see or toggle per-route costs, we can't roll this out across our teams — the finance team will say no." I added notes + example routes to the tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RI-4621 (linked).

Diego (Support): fwiw we've had 3 other onboarding accounts mention per-route cost breakdowns / toggles this quarter — def not an isolated ask. putting a 👍 on this.

Maya (CS): suggestion — we should pull 5 representative routes + token usage and attach a mock cost view to RI-4621. i can grab those by EOD.

Elliot (Product Ops): quick q — are they asking for a simple admin toggle (on/off) or full per-route cost reporting in billing exports? very different scopes. toggle could be fast, reporting needs infra/analytics.

Priya (CS): SolarWave prioritized the toggle as blocking the pilot; they also want the breakdown long-term. so short term = toggle for `internal/*` routes, long term = per-route billing export.

Jordan (PM): proposal: triage RI-4621 with labels `onboarding-blocker`, `renewal-risk`, `cs-signal`. I'll slot this for Friday triage (10am PT). can someone add an impact score (1-5) and rough effort (S/M/L)?

Maya (CS): impact 4, effort S for toggle, M-L for full breakdown. i'll attach sample routes + CSV to the ticket.

Elliot (Product Ops): agreed. proposed acceptance criteria for toggle: admin can enable/disable per-route billing at account level; routes matching configured patterns (e.g. `internal/*`) are excluded from invoice; exclusion takes effect next billing cycle; feature gated behind `billing.route_visibility` feature flag. example config snippet:

```
billing:
  route_visibility: true
  exclude_patterns:
    - internal/*
```

Priya (CS): +1. i'll surface this in the renewal playbook call with the AM and confirm timeline. tagging @tickets-bot to attach the sample CSV and link to renewal runbook.

tickets-bot: Ticket RI-4621 updated — labels set: [onboarding-blocker, renewal-risk, cs-signal]; attachment: sample_routes.csv.

Jordan (PM): thanks everyone — we'll aim to scope the toggle for next sprint and revisit the breakdown after triage. :thumbsup:
